title: IBM says it is developing a dual-architecture processor for IBM Z and LinuxONE systems that can natively execute both IBM's z/OS workloads and Arm applications (Michael Nuñez/VentureBeat)
summary: Michael Nuñez / VentureBeat: IBM says it is developing a dual-architecture processor for IBM Z and LinuxONE systems that can natively execute both IBM's z/OS workloads and Arm applications — IBM is announcing today at the annual Hot Chips conference what may be the most consequential change to mainframe architecture in decades …
